smell: Most exported model classes carry class-level $I.annote annotations but their public fields are raw schema members without .annotateKey descriptions, including tool calls, messages, request fields, usage, response choices, chunks, and errors.
proposedTarget: Add .annotateKey descriptions to public DTO fields, following packages/drivers/m365/src/M365.schemas.ts:22 and packages/drivers/govinfo/src/domain/values/SummaryItem/SummaryItem.model.ts:41. Effect v4 exposes annotateKey at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:185 and :605.

smell: Internal StreamState is a schema class with no class-level $I.annote metadata and no field-level annotations, unlike the surrounding exported OpenAI-compatible schemas.
proposedTarget: Add a class-level $I.annote("StreamState", { description: ... }) and annotateKey entries for buffer/decoder/toolCalls to keep streaming state visible to schema/doc tooling.

smell: maxTokens, seed, temperature, topP, frequencyPenalty, and presencePenalty are modeled as optional S.Finite, so fractional token counts, negative seeds, and out-of-range sampling controls decode.
proposedTarget: Use PosInt from @beep/schema/Int (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Int.ts:77) for maxTokens, NonNegativeInt from packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Number.ts:182 for seed, UnitInterval from packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/UnitInterval.ts:32 for topP, and bounded S.Finite checks using S.isBetween (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:7401) for temperature/penalties.

symbol: tool/choice indices and usage token counts
smell: Tool-call index, choice index, and usage token counts share broad optional number helpers or S.Finite, accepting negative/fractional values for zero-based indexes and token totals.
proposedTarget: Use NonNegativeInt for indexes and prompt/completion/total token counts. Keep fields optional/nullish where the OpenAI-compatible provider omits them; only narrow the numeric domain.

smell: Driver-owned request construction accepts an empty messages array and empty model id even though real chat-completion requests require at least one message and a non-empty model identifier.
proposedTarget: Use S.NonEmptyArray(OpenAiCompatChatMessage) for messages (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:4533) and S.NonEmptyString for model (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8420); update transport-only fixtures that currently use messages: [] to use a minimal user message or a raw bypass for negative transport tests.

smell: The suite has strong provider/streaming fixtures but no S.toArbitrary-derived schema law for the large hand-authored model surface.
proposedTarget: Add additive property tests for representative request, message, response, chunk, usage, and error schemas using S.toArbitrary (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:12970) and S.toEquivalence (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:13201), with custom handling for open JSON-schema records where needed.

smell: Detector candidate: content arrays, JSON-schema parameters, finish_reason, provider metadata, and other fields remain broad strings or S.Record(S.String, S.Unknown).
proposedTarget: Keep provider extension fields broad; focus S5 narrowing on local request/config invariants and numeric domains.

exception.reason: The package deliberately targets OpenAI-compatible providers, so multimodal content, JSON schema parameters, tool schemas, finish reasons, and provider-specific metadata need extension room beyond a closed first-party model.

exception.reason: The fixtures pin request body forwarding, provider error mapping, stream reconstruction, redaction, and compatibility behavior; generated schema data would not replace those behavioral checks.
